judgments.reason: The span 'Biopsy of the toe ulcer showed necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus.' appears literally in the vignette and documents TB involvement of a peripheral site (right hallux), supporting disseminated (multi-site) tuberculosis.

The span 'Chest radiograph showed bilateral reticular-nodular opacities.' appears literally in the vignette and documents pulmonary TB involvement, one of multiple sites supporting disseminated tuberculosis.
